answer: Prism-Epoch Consistency Gate: each agent publishes a walnut-salted sketch of its interaction trace per epoch—latency quantiles, action-transition entropy, peer-diversity—plus a crystal-chained commitment to the prior sketch. For high-value actions, auditors randomly sample prior epochs and require cosine consistency above τ and exact chain verification. A sybil must operate each identity for many epochs with stable, non-cloneable behavior; N identities cost N× epoch-long compute, trace storage, and coordination, while any prism mismatch quarantines it.
